card.name: Linking words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (of, other, and, and/or, comma, e.g.) inside warning passages written in ALL CAPS. Also partway through a capitalized word like BRONCHOSPASTIC.

modes.label: Linking words in caps
modes.description: Words like OF, OTHER, AND, and a comma inside an all-caps warning sentence about drug use.
modes.example: RATORY PARALYSIS FROM NEUROMUSCULAR BLOCKAGE, ESPECIALLY WHEN THE DRUG IS GIVEN SOON AFTER THE USE<< OF>> ANESTHESIA OR MUS

modes.label: Inside capitalized medical words
modes.description: The CH or OUS piece partway through an all-caps medical word.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue in upper case, favoring capitalized word starts like POST, REST and DOM.
card.plain: It marks all-caps warning text and nudges the next word to also be written in capitals.
